stories.title: US and Iran reach deal to end war, signing set for Friday
stories.summary: US and Iranian officials say they have agreed on a peace framework for a deal to end their war, halt the US blockade of Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. "The Deal with the Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete," US President Donald Trump wrote on his Truth Social platform. His post came shortly after Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, whose country has served as a mediator, announced a deal had been struck. The pact will be officially signed on Friday in Switzerland, Mr Sharif wrote.

stories.title: Wicklow search in Dullard, Jacob investigations
stories.summary: Gardaí investigating the disappearance of Jo Jo Dullard and Deirdre Jacob have recommenced a search operation on open ground in an area near the border between Wicklow and Kildare. The Defence Forces assisted gardaí last week - under aid to civil power arrangements - in completing a ground survey of the area in Co Wicklow. The land will now be searched and subject to excavation and forensic examinations over the coming days. The search operation is being led by the Serious Crime Review Team, the Garda National Bureau of Criminal Investigation in conjunction with gardaí from the Kildare/Carlow Division.

stories.title: UK to ban social media for under-16s
stories.summary: Children under age 16 will be banned from social media in the UK, British Prime Minister Keir Starmer has said. Mr Starmer announced the restriction at a Downing Street press conference as he warned social media was having an impact on children's happiness and mental health. He said he would not compromise on the "safety and happiness of our children". He said he was confident the ban can be effective but acknowledged some children would find their way around it.

stories.title: Kerry to clash with Armagh, Dublin host Donegal
stories.summary: Reigning champions Kerry will welcome Armagh to the Kingdom and Donegal travel to Dublin in the standout All-Ireland SFC Round 3 ties to be played this weekend. Mayo have been drawn at home to Meath, and Monaghan paired with Westmeath in the other two clashes. Armagh were stunned by Louth in Round 2A on Sunday, losing by a point after Sam Mulroy's buzzer-beater goal at the very death in Inniskeen. Kerry reignited their All-Ireland title defence with a straightforward win against Kildare on Saturday.

stories.title: Dig unearthing Ireland and Norway's Viking past
stories.summary: A team of archaeologists from Ireland and Norway is aiming to unearth more of the two countries' shared Viking past at an archaeological dig near Waterford city. The excavation is taking place in a field in a townland called Woodstown on the banks of the River Suir, just west of the city. The Woodstown Viking site was first discovered in 2003, by a small team of archaeologists, in advance of the construction of the N25 Waterford City Bypass. They found a Viking settlement that had been forgotten for over a millennium.
